description: This file contains unit tests for thread yielding behavior, including functions that test thread scheduling and yield performance on Raspberry Pi 4 (64-bit) platform, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: IsYielder
methods.description: Determines if a thread index is designated as a yielder for a given trial, alternating to avoid bias.

methods.name: YieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that yields control repeatedly to test scheduler behavior.

methods.name: UnyieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that does not yield, used for comparison in scheduling tests.
